name: openship
one_liner: Point it at your code repository and it automatically builds, deploys, and manages your web app on your own server — a self-hosted alternative to Vercel or Heroku.
buyer: A small agency or freelance developer hosting multiple client sites who wants to stop paying per-project fees to Vercel or Render.
business_use_cases: A web agency hosts 20 client sites on one cheap VPS instead of 20 separate Vercel project bills.
A bootstrapped SaaS founder sets up push-to-deploy CI/CD on their own server to avoid platform lock-in and hosting markups as they scale.
A dev shop offers clients 'we host and deploy your app for a flat monthly fee' using Openship as the underlying infrastructure.

money_ideas.idea: Resell managed Openship hosting to small businesses as a flat-fee 'we deploy and maintain your site' service.
Offer paid migration services moving agencies off Vercel/Heroku onto self-hosted Openship to cut their hosting bills.

steal_this: This weekend, spin up Openship on a $20/month VPS, migrate three of your own side projects off paid hosting, and pitch the savings as a service to freelancer friends still paying per-project platform fees.
